description.shortText: Underground vacuum pipes scattered throughout the city, able to suck up waste and transport it to a waste collection terminal. This technology could improve waste recycling, reduce city smells and the noise from collection trucks, and improve air quality by lowering truck traffic.

attachments.name: Norway wins Energy Globe Award for groundbreaking system
attachments.description: The City of Bergen has won the National Energy Globe Award 2017 for its decision to install Envac, the global pioneer of automated waste collection, within its historical city centre.

attachments.name: Envac to Install Major Underground Waste Collection System in London
attachments.description: Swedish Automated Waste Collection System (AWCS) developer, Envac, is to supply one of the largest such systems in Europe to handle the waste of almost 10,000 homes at Barking Riverside London.
